text:
maya: Heads-up — bringing up rwdv7-quant4 as a small canary on chat endpoints. Proposing a composite safety sampler + A/B gate for automatic fallback. Short summary below.
eric: sgtm, can you paste the composite formula and thresholds? curious about weights.
maya: ```
# composite used by gate (informal)
composite_score = 0.6 * abs(MRR_delta) + 0.3 * halluc_rate_delta + 0.1 * norm(p99_latency_ms / 1000)
# thresholds (canary auto actions)
#  - auto_fallback if composite_score > 0.02 OR (MRR_drop > 0.012 && halluc_increase > 0.008)
#  - soft_alert if composite_score > 0.01
# fallback action: immediate route to rwdv7-fp16 (previous stable) + open incident channel
# cohort seeding: rare_entity, longctx, rerank-edge (5% each)
```
sofia: For the seeded slices: recommend we force a minimum of 2000 samples across each cohort during the first 6h. Run 24h smoke and then 72h observation before any ramp. Also add a "rerank parity" boolean check: if rerank precision drops > 1.5pp on the rerank-edge slice, treat as unblockable fail.
tim: Agree on fallback target. Add latency circuit: if p99 latency > 300ms sustained over a 10m sliding window, trigger circuit-breaker (immediate fallback, no manual approval).
maya: Plan: start at 5% traffic (seed cohorts), then if all soft_alerts clear after 2h, bump to 25% for wider sampling. If any auto_fallback condition triggers, system will cut traffic and route to rwdv7-fp16 and post an incident.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started — traffic=5% at 1715070015, variant=rwdv7-quant4 :rocket:
qa-bot: Quick smoke: ran 1k sampled requests through seeded cohorts. Observed metrics (initial): MRR_delta = -0.003 (-0.3%), halluc_rate_delta = +0.004 (+0.4pp), p99_latency_delta = +12ms. composite_score ~ 0.006 -> below soft_alert. No auto_fallback.
eric: OK. keep watch on longctx and rare_entity; if halluc increases on longctx slice we should immediate roll back even if other metrics look fine.
sofia: +1. I'll run targeted rerank diffs and a small contrastive eval set later today and post results here.
maya: Thanks — I'll wire these checks into the rollout config and add a devops runbook for manual override (instructions + commands). Quick note: the auto-fallback logic will also emit a concise reason string (e.g. "MRR_drop:1.4%|halluc:+0.9pp") so ops can triage faster.
eric: Nice. ping me if we see composite_score > 0.01.
maya: Will do. Starting monitoring dash and alerting now. :eyes:
